description: This file defines the CountThings class which is a command implementation for counting specified 'things' based on optional filters and namespaces. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata about the command.

classes.name: CountThings
classes.description: A final immutable command class for counting things with optional filters and namespaces, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.
